decision: Remove seven local X86GFX abort frames. R1119 already has the original WINDOWED predicate and now also has its original conditional structure. Actual original preprocessor exclusions are preserved.
retained_boundaries: The software fullscreen route still calls the original paint and VGA geometry/cursor operations. Restoring the original WINDOWED guards would skip these operations and in one path leave consoleHeight unassigned.
The original X86GFX hardware branch remains excluded. Its split retains getNtScreenState for the actual keyboard consumer while hardware mode-switch functions remain unselected.
The retained font restore and CHAIN2 differences have existing focused controls. The monitor-only AddTempIVTFixups provider remains within the established hardware-monitor exclusion scope.

verification.console_font_fixture: PASS font restoration; old-code control fails

release.action: No production relink, republication or repeat of Full. Selected product inputs and logical lines are identical.
